name: Cuirithir

attributes.attribute: figure tied to the account of Liadan

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The source prints the name Cuirithir only as a pointer. It sends the reader to the account of Liadan for the fuller story.

okr.objective: Cuirithir is a companion whose story is easier to follow under Liadan.
key_results: The leaf is only a cross reference to Liadan.
The full story sits under the name Liadan.
The name serves chiefly as a route into the Liadan account.
